notes: Use the official Digital SAT Advanced Math constructs: equivalent expressions; nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables; nonlinear functions.

A TEKS alignment never authorizes every aspect of the Texas standard. Log-specific, technology-only, interval-notation-only, or three-variable-system aspects remain excluded when they fall outside the SAT construct.

Standards marked review-domain require a column-level or construct-level review before authoring. Standards marked author are approved for V2.1 authoring but are not publishable until their 5 direct + 3 independently authored challenge bank passes validation.
Algebra-domain banks and Advanced-Math banks may share a TEKS only when they assess genuinely different official SAT skill families.

A Texas alignment checkmark is not by itself permission to broaden an SAT construct. A2.6F remains review-domain because the detailed SAT Advanced Math framework explicitly names linear absolute-value equations, while the Texas table separately marks the broader inequality TEKS as aligned.
